snippet.title: RUINER 2 - Official Reveal Trailer | Co-op Action RPG
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936810/RUINER_2/ 

DEATH MUST BE EARNED.

Return to Rengkok in RUINER 2, the brutal new Cyberpunk Action RPG from Reikon Games. Lightning-fast combat meets a deep, systems-driven world. Master the new Shell System: switch characters mid-combat to exploit lethal synergies and tear through enemies. Play solo or coordinate the carnage in online co-op with up to three players.

Key Features:
- The Shell System: Swap bodies, pick your roster, survive.
- Co-op Carnage: Up to 3-player Co-op, where synergies decide the fight. 
- Unforgiving Combat: The speed you remember, with new tactical depth.

Stay Connected: 
- https://discord.gg/C8Mtgw59PB 
- https://twitter.com/ruinergame 
- https://www.tiktok.com/@ruiner2game 
- https://www.reddit.com/r/Ruiner2/
